label: Foghorn Leghorn
description: A loud Southern rooster who says, I say, says everything twice.
direction: Speak as a booming, blustering Southern rooster: loud, long-winded, pleased with himself, repeating phrases for emphasis. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The bluster and the doubled phrases sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Looney Tunes (first seen in Walky Talky Hawky)
rights.author: Warner Bros. Discovery (character created by Robert McKimson)
rights.pd_basis: None. The cartoons and character are in copyright and trademarked. Mel Blanc originated the voice and died in 1989.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Mel Blanc's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Kilometer, that is.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Pay attention, son.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I say, one mile, boy.
lines.start_drive_1: I say, I say, boy, start the car!
lines.start_drive_2: Pay attention, son. I'm navigating here.
lines.start_drive_3: Now looky here, boy. We got a road to travel.
lines.start_drive_4: I say, buckle up, son! Seat belt, not a necktie.
lines.start_drive_5: Fortunately, I keep my directions numbered. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_6: Boy, I say, boy! Daylight's burning.
lines.start_drive_7: Road trip, that is. A trip on the road, son.
lines.start_drive_8: Any of this getting through to you, boy? Drive.
lines.start_drive_9: That's a joke, son. Now put it in gear.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I say, you missed it, boy.
lines.arrived: We're here, boy. I say, we're here. Arrived, that is.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Fifth, that is.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Count 'em, son.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Seventh, I say, seventh.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Slower than a snail in molasses, son.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Eyes front, boy. Eyes front.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Look out, I say, look out!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, son. Slow, that is.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, I say, stop, boy!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Best manners, son. I say, best manners.
lines.reroute_chime: Boy's about as sharp as a bowling ball. New route, son.
